text:
Predicates:
Romance(x) ::: x is a Romance language.
IndoEuropean(x) ::: x is an Indo-European language.
LanguageFamily(x) ::: x is a language family.
Related(x, y) ::: x is related to y.
French(x) ::: x is French.
Spanish(x) ::: x is Spanish.
German(x) ::: x is German.
Basque(x) ::: x is Basque.
Premises:
∀x (Romance(x) → IndoEuropean(x)) ::: All Romance languages are Indo-European languages.
∀x (Romance(x) → LanguageFamily(x)) ::: The Romance languages are a language family.
∀x ∀y (LanguageFamily(x) ∧ LanguageFamily(y) → Related(x, y)) ::: All languages within a language family are related to each other.
Romance(french) ∧ Romance(spanish) ::: French and Spanish are both Romance languages.
Related(german, spanish) ::: German is related to Spanish.
∀x ¬Related(basque, x) ⊕ x = basque ::: Basque is not related to any other language.
Conclusion:
IndoEuropean(french) ::: French is an Indo-European language.
